episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Woo Sin enters Kwon's mansion in search of Adamas. Su Hyeon begins to question his father's death.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Woo Sin tries to lure Tae Sung into his plan while Soo Hyun meets with a witness.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Woosin's plan is on the verge of collapsing and Soohyun's witness is suddenly found dead.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Woo-sin lights a fire in the mansion to find Adamas and Su-hyeon receives a mysterious text message.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Woo-sin plans to steal Adamas, and Su-hyeon interrogates the person who followed him.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Woosin searches for the disappeared Adamas and Soohyun and Seohee are ambushed by Team A.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Woo Sin asks Hye Soo for help to keep Mrs. Oh silent, and Soo Hyun and Seo Hee find out who Team A is.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Woo Sin writes a novel about Soon Yi's dead son and Soo Hyun tries to secure his father's autopsy report.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Woo Shin took the 80th anniversary of the Haesong group as a D-day, when Adamas was re-released. They move to be invited to the ceremony. Hye Soo wants to find out who Woo-shin's assistant is. Soo Hyun and Seo Hee escape from the inside of the special edition and head to Team A's main camp, ARES.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Team A escapes Suhyeon's pursuit and succeeds in kidnapping Seohee, and Suhyeon sets out to rescue Seohee with a special copy. General Choi points out Kim Yo-won as the person who took the missing satellite phone, but Woo-shin is not certain that Kim Yo-won is.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Woo Shin carries out his plan to steal Adamas. Soo Hyun receives an invitation and heads to the hall.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: Woo Sin tries to understand Kwon's true intentions, and Su Hyeon makes an all-out effort to save Seo Hee.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.summary: Su Hyeon meets Lee Chang Woo and learns the truth. Woo Sin looks into the Kangchun prison incident.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.summary: Woo Sin becomes a hostage of Team A. Su Hyeon and Seo Hee go to save Woo Sin.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.summary: Woo Sin searches for the missing figure and Su Hyeon follows the clues left by Team A.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.summary: Suh-yeon bumps into Jung-yeong on Team A's black site. Woo-sin and Seo-hui run to Suh-yeon's rescue.
